q2_gaps: N-of-N nominal compound ("a means of travel"): the Compound-concepts taxonomy covers only verb_object, verb_particle and modifier_noun (head noun last), so nothing licenses fusing a head noun with its of-complement, and nothing says what decomposition it takes — here the genus (Inheritance means_of_travel means) is emitted but `travel` is left wholly unexposed.
notes: Indefinite "a car" in a copular/definitional predication correctly becomes the generic Inheritance rather than a witness. The definitional 0.99 vs empirical 0.9 dial setting is a borderline call here, but reading "a car is a means of travel" as taxonomic is defensible.
